note: mods: [mod, waiting, approve, seeded, ranAfter(true, mod, add), ranAfter(true, mod, restore)]; ranAfter: [held, mod, how, want]. Recorded from the iPhone's Mods.swift hold rules before the move (round 4, 11-18): waiting, allow, approve, changeNeeds, seeded, ranAfter (ModStore.add / restore's kept version). Part 2 (round 5, 11-18), recorded from Mods.swift's ModStore.add / undoAdd / remove / undoDelete / restoreDeleted / reject / restore (its carry-over) with the time fixed: add: [old|null, mod, source, now, changed, want]; undoAdd: [ids, id, hasBefore, want]; remove: [trash, by, now, want]; undoDelete: [last, ids, trash mod ids, want]; restoreDeleted: [entry, trash, ids, last, want]; reject: [cur, now, want]; restore: [cur, source, now, want]. History and Recently deleted ages are 1 ms either side of 30 days (exactly 30 days is float noise in Swift's Date). Changed 11-18 (Tim): a restore while a change waits keeps what that change was keeping (the last approved version), as an add does: mods' ranAfter(true, mod, restore) for a held mod with ran is 'ran' (was null); ranAfter gained held cases.
